claim: Netflix's quarter ended March 2023 report put net income at $1.3B, with revenue of $9.2 billion.
summary: Netflix Q1 2023 (quarter ended March 31, 2023) reported net income of $1.305B, consistent with ~$1.3B, but reported revenue was $8.162B, not $9.2B, so the revenue assertion is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Netflix issued a report for the quarter ended March 2023
sub_claims.note: Netflix reports on calendar quarters; Q1 2023 ended March 31, 2023 and was reported in April 2023.

sub_claims.text: Netflix's net income for the quarter ended March 2023 was $1.3B
sub_claims.note: Netflix Q1 2023 net income was $1.305B, which rounds to $1.3B, consistent with the claim.

sub_claims.text: Netflix's revenue for the quarter ended March 2023 was $9.2 billion
sub_claims.note: Netflix Q1 2023 revenue was $8.162B, not $9.2B. The claimed $9.2B overstates actual revenue by over $1B (about 13%).
